# assignmentB2SambhavGoyal

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of assignmentB2SambhavGoyal is to provide functions for transforming and scaling numeric vectors using various mathematical approaches.

## Installation

You can install the development version of assignmentB2SambhavGoyal from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2SambhavGoyal")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem: (...Think of something creative...)

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2SambhavGoyal)
## basic example code

product_prices <- c(2, 2.15, NA, 2.76, 1.99)

# Lets find prices after the scaling
assignmentB2SambhavGoyal::min_max_transform(product_prices, replaceNA = TRUE)
```
